description: This file defines the NullCache class implementing a no-cache strategy in Twig's caching system. It provides stub methods for cache operations, effectively disabling caching.

classes.name: NullCache
classes.description: Implements a no-cache strategy by providing empty method implementations and returning default values.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key based on name and class name; here it returns an empty string.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stub method for writing to cache; does nothing.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Stub method for loading cache; does nothing.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns 0 indicating no timestamp is stored.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Stub method for removing cache entries; does nothing.
